Attention shoppers; the Jokers make mischief by taking unflattering pictures of grocery store patrons, then posing as horrible employees at the Yeti store; tonight's loser must meet his fate in a punishment.

title: Impractical Jokers
description:
S12 E08 — Dopamine Denier
The Jokers play unprofessional actors in a fake commercial then make wild assumptions about other mall goers; one Joker breaks and is tasked with becoming the strictest security guard imaginable in his punishment.

title: Impractical Jokers
description:
S12 E09 — Hoop! There It Is!
The Jokers pretend to be medical students in training with standardized patient actors, then play the hero and break up a public fight, hoping to earn applause; one Joker has to put his hips where his mouth is and settle a bet of his own making.

title: Impractical Jokers
description:
S13 E01 — Meal, Interrupted
Sal, Q and Murr flag down a Good Samaritan for help from their broken-down car, then impersonate corpses in a funeral home with Adam Ray.
